name: Web Fetch
description: Fetches a web page and returns its readable text content (HTML stripped), plus the page title. Gives an agent the ability to actually read a URL the owner or another agent points it at.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL over HTTP(S) and return the page title and its main readable text with HTML tags, scripts, and styles removed. Use when you need to read the actual content of a specific web page.

url.description: The full http(s) URL to fetch.

max_chars.description: Optional cap on returned text length (default 8000).
